results2 = retrieve(
    query_text="vegetarian loves veggie burger delicious",

)

# Combine all unique results

for r in results + results2:

    prompt = f"""Analyze this restaurant review and answer two questions:

Review:
"{text[:2000]}"

Answer in format:
Vegetarian: [Yes/No/Unclear]
Enjoyed burger: [Yes/No/Unclear/N/A]"""
    prompts.append(prompt)

print(f"Sending {len(prompts)} prompts to LLM...")
responses = llm_query_batched(prompts)

for i, (rid, resp) in enumerate(zip(review_ids, responses)):
